ownership_excerpt: Brad Baumler, Owner of CTI Ready Mix, stated that CTI would want to use the facility as long as they can and anticipates the location will be a long-term location. He stated his hopes for twenty to thirty years with possibility of extending it if they have the materials close to the location. Baumler repeated CTI wants to go as long as they possibly can and that he owns the business and plans on being on the site, running it for some time and has family that wishes to do so in the future.
event: At the Story County conditional use permit hearing for a CTI Ready Mix concrete plant, owner Brad Baumler described the project as a new four-million-dollar plant and a long-term capacity commitment connected to the company's Des Moines metro plants. The commission approved the permit.
signal_source_title: Story County Planning and Zoning Commission Minutes, October 1, 2025
evidence_excerpt: Baumler stated this is a new plant and four-million-dollar facility and that CTI Ready Mix is making a commitment and does not want to take it down too soon.
why_exit_factor: Inference: a new four-million-dollar ready-mix plant is a capacity investment that extends production from the Des Moines metro into Story County for an owner-led concrete business.
personalized_opener: Brad, Story County's October 1, 2025 planning minutes quote you, as owner of CTI Ready Mix, describing the new plant as a four-million-dollar facility you plan to run long term alongside the Des Moines metro plants.
